 ☐ Cache

How should toolbox cache build artifacts between runs of the scratch pipeline?

  1. Local disk (Recommended)
     Keep artifacts in a directory beside the worktree, cleared when the worktree is removed;
     fastest, and nothing leaves the machine
  2. Object store
     Upload artifacts to a shared bucket so every runner can reuse them, at the cost of a network
     round trip per job
  3. No cache
     Rebuild everything every time; slowest, but there is nothing that can ever go stale or be
     shared by mistake
  4. Per-branch
     One cache per branch, so a long-lived branch keeps its own warm cache and a short one starts
     cold
❯ 5. shared disk on the runner
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
